title: Loan or credit offer
summary: A loan offer asks for an advance fee, code, or sensitive identity information.
scenario: The offer uses fast approval and urgency to bypass lender verification.
warning_signs: Advance fee before a loan decision
Requests for credentials or remote access
safe_actions: Do not pay an advance fee based on an incoming message
Verify the lender through an independently found route
recovery_guidance: Contact your bank or payment provider if money was sent
Secure accounts and keep all documents and receipts
reporting_guidance: Preserve the offer and payment trail
Use an independently verified reporting route
prevention_tips: Compare lender details using more than the supplied contact
Treat fast approval as a reason to verify, not to rush
false_positive_notes: A real lender may request documents through a secure process; the lender identity must be checked first.
